Building the evidence file as a **collection schedule only** — nothing here is asserted to exist. Every item is a record to *request and verify*, with placeholders for items not yet known (claim number, FNOL date). Plan: (1) master evidence schedule mapped to the open coverage issues, (2) chain-of-custody log template (empty), (3) gap analysis showing which open question each item resolves.

```python
import pandas as pd
from datetime import date

pd.set_option("display.width", 250)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 78)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 300)

TODAY = date(2026, 10, 12)
CLAIM_REF = "<not yet assigned / not supplied>"
FNOL_DATE = "<not supplied>"

# EST = item exists but not obtained; unknown = may or may not exist (must be asked for)
EST, UNK = "Outstanding - request", "Outstanding - confirm existence"

# ---------------- TABLE 1: MASTER EVIDENCE SCHEDULE ----------------
rows = [
 # id, category, document/data, why needed (supports), custodian, likely format, priority, status, resolves issue
 ("EV-01","Policy documents","Declarations page, CP-2024-1187","Confirms named insured, scheduled premises, water damage limit ($500k), deductible ($5k) basis, endorsements","Carrier / producer of record","PDF","Critical",EST,"Limit & deductible structure; schedule of premises"),
 ("EV-02","Policy documents","Full policy jacket incl. forms & endorsements","Establishes grant of coverage, Water Damage peril wording, all exclusions and conditions","Carrier","PDF","Critical",EST,"Exclusion & condition screen"),
 ("EV-03","Policy documents","Water damage / water backup / mold endorsements","Determines whether mold sublimit, backup coverage, or sewer/drain extension applies","Carrier / producer","PDF","Critical",EST,"Mold sublimit; sewer vs supply line"),
 ("EV-04","Policy documents","Notice & proof-of-loss conditions; suit-limitation clause","Tests late notice and any contractual time bar","Carrier","PDF","Critical",EST,"Late notice / suit limitation"),
 ("EV-05","Claim documents","FNOL / first report of loss + date and method reported","Establishes the actual reporting date treated as notice","Carrier claims system / insured","PDF / system record","Critical",EST,"Prompt-notice condition"),

 ("EV-06","Claim documents","Claim number, adjuster assignment, claim diary notes","Administrative binder and audit trail","Carrier","System record","High",EST,"Intake completeness"),
 ("EV-07","Claim documents","Signed and sworn proof of loss with supporting schedule","Formal claim and starts WA 15-working-day response clock","Insured / PA","PDF","Critical",EST,"WAC 284-30-380 clock"),
 ("EV-08","Claim documents","Any earlier correspondence between insured and carrier re: this loss","May evidence prior notice earlier than intake","Both parties","PDF / email","High",EST,"Prompt-notice condition"),

 ("EV-09","Cause & origin","Plumber / licensed contractor report on the failed pipe","Identifies which pipe, failure mode (freeze / corrosion / mechanical), single rupture vs. leak","Licensed plumber","PDF","Critical",EST,"Covered peril; freeze & seepage exclusions"),
 ("EV-10","Cause & origin","Cause & origin engineer report","Independent determination of cause, duration, and mode","Retained engineer","PDF","High",EST,"Seepage-over-14-days; freeze"),
 ("EV-11","Cause & origin","Internal pipe camera / borescope inspection footage","Distinguishes supply vs. waste line; shows pipe condition over time","Plumber / engineer","Video","High",EST,"Sewer-backup vs. supply-line"),
 ("EV-12","Cause & origin","Retained failed pipe section / fitting (preserved artifact)","Physical evidence for metallurgical or failure analysis","Insured / plumber","Physical","Medium",EST,"Failure mode; subrogation"),

 ("EV-13","Photographic","Pre-loss condition photographs (interior, plumbing, ceiling)","Establishes baseline condition before the loss","Insured / landlord","JPEG","High",EST,"Pre-existing wear & tear"),
 ("EV-14","Photographic","Date-stamped post-loss scene photographs","Documents extent and location of water damage","Insured / adjuster","JPEG","Critical",EST,"Scope of damage"),
 ("EV-15","Photographic","Moisture-mapping / thermal-imaging images","Shows migration path and affected areas","Restoration vendor","JPEG / PDF","High",EST,"Damage extent; mold exposure"),
 ("EV-16","Photographic","Video walkthrough of affected areas","Continuous record of conditions at time of inspection","Insured / adjuster","Video","Medium",EST,"Damage extent"),

 ("EV-17","Damage quantification","Repair estimates from licensed contractors (2-3 quotes)","Establishes cost of repair to building interior and finishes","Contractors","PDF","Critical",EST,"Loss amount; RCV vs ACV"),
 ("EV-18","Damage quantification","Building interior finish / flooring / drywall replacement scope","Itemized repair scope","Contractor","PDF","High",EST,"Loss amount"),
 ("EV-19","Damage quantification","Inventory of damaged stock / business personal property with values","Quantifies BPP and stock loss","Insured / CPA","XLSX","High",EST,"BPP loss"),
 ("EV-20","Damage quantification","Purchase invoices / asset register for damaged items","Supports valuation and depreciation","Insured","PDF / XLSX","High",EST,"RCV vs ACV"),
 ("EV-21","Damage quantification","Assessor / building valuation data","Confirms building value for coinsurance test","Insured / carrier","PDF","Medium",EST,"Coinsurance %"),
 ("EV-22","Damage quantification","Original building plans / specifications","Shows as-built configuration of plumbing and structure","Owner / city records","PDF","Low",EST,"Scope accuracy"),

 ("EV-23","Mitigation","Emergency mitigation / water extraction invoice and report","Documents timeliness and scope of mitigation","Restoration vendor","PDF","Critical",EST,"Duty to mitigate"),
 ("EV-24","Mitigation","Drying logs / daily moisture readings","Shows duration and effectiveness of mitigation; dates","Restoration vendor","PDF / XLSX","Critical",EST,"Seepage duration; mold"),
 ("EV-25","Mitigation","Mold remediation scope, lab results, clearances","Quantifies separate mold exposure against sublimit","Remediation vendor / lab","PDF","High",EST,"Mold sublimit"),
 ("EV-26","Mitigation","Dehumidifier / air-mover equipment logs","Corroborates mitigation timeline","Restoration vendor","PDF","Medium",EST,"Duty to mitigate"),

 ("EV-27","Maintenance / history","Building maintenance and plumbing service records","Shows whether pipe failure resulted from wear/deterioration over time","Insured / landlord / plumbing co.","PDF","High",EST,"Wear & tear; seepage condition"),
 ("EV-28","Maintenance / history","Records of any prior leaks, repairs, or complaints at this premises","Establishes whether this was a recurrent problem","Insured / tenants","PDF","High",EST,"Repeated seepage exclusion"),
 ("EV-29","Maintenance / history","Invoices for recent plumbing repairs / renovations","Tests faulty-workmanship exclusion","Insured / contractors","PDF","High",EST,"Faulty workmanship"),
 ("EV-30","Maintenance / history","Loss runs / prior claim history for this location","Identifies prior similar losses","Carrier","PDF","Medium",EST,"Recurrence; underwriting"),
 ("EV-31","Maintenance / history","Contractor licenses and insurance certificates","Verifies parties; supports subrogation","Contractors","PDF","Low",EST,"Subrogation"),

 ("EV-32","Occupancy / operations","Proof of occupancy status at date of loss (POS, staff records, utilities)","Defeats the vacancy exclusion","Insured","PDF","Critical",EST,"Vacancy exclusion"),
 ("EV-33","Occupancy / operations","HVAC / heating records or utility bills Oct-Nov 2024","Tests the freezing exclusion requirement (heat maintained)","Insured / utility","PDF","Critical",EST,"Freezing exclusion"),
 ("EV-34","Occupancy / operations","Store operating hours / sales records around 15 Nov 2024","Corroborates the store was open and occupied","Insured","XLSX","High",EST,"Vacancy exclusion"),

 ("EV-35","Financial / BI","Business interruption / extra expense worksheets","Quantifies time-element loss if claimed","Insured / CPA","XLSX","High",EST,"BI coverage (if endorsed)"),
 ("EV-36","Financial / BI","Audited or management financial statements (2023-2024)","Supports BI loss calculation and coinsurance limits","Insured / CPA","PDF","Medium",EST,"BI quantum"),
 ("EV-37","Financial / BI","Rent / lease agreement","Establishes ownership vs. leasehold and insured interest","Insured / landlord","PDF","High",EST,"Insurable interest"),

 ("EV-38","Weather / environmental","NOAA / NWS Seattle temperature & precipitation records for Nov 2024","Independent test of freezing conditions and storm activity at DOL","NWS / NOAA","PDF / CSV","High",EST,"Freezing exclusion; flood"),
 ("EV-39","Weather / environmental","Local property-manager / neighbor reports of concurrent flooding","Rules out exterior water / surface water cause","Third parties","Written stmt","Medium",EST,"Flood exclusion"),

 ("EV-40","Legal / third party","Contractor / plumber contracts and warranties for the building systems","Identifies responsible third party for subrogation","Insured","PDF","Medium",EST,"Subrogation"),
 ("EV-41","Legal / third party","Mortgagee / loss payee details & lender notification","Ensures correct payee on any settlement","Lender","PDF","High",EST,"Payment / loss payee"),
 ("EV-42","Legal / third party","Statements / recorded interviews from insured and witnesses","Corroborates timeline and cause","Insured / witnesses","Audio / transcript","Medium",EST,"Prompt notice; cause"),
 ("EV-43","Legal / third party","Reservation-of-rights letter and any coverage position issued","Establishes carrier's stated position and dates","Carrier","PDF",'High',EST,"Coverage posture"),

 ("EV-44","Verification","Certified copies of any doc where authenticity is in question","Chain-of-custody and authentication","Document holder","Certified copy","Medium",UNK,"Admissibility / proof"),
]

cols = ["Evidence ID","Category","Document / data to collect","Why it is needed (supports)","Custodian / source","Likely format","Priority","Status",'Issue it resolves']
ev = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=cols)

# ---------------- TABLE 2: CHAIN OF CUSTODY LOG TEMPLATE (empty) ----------------
coc = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
    "Evidence ID","Description","Received from","Received by","Date received","Method",
    "Format / media","Condition on receipt","Location stored","Handled by","Notes"])

# ---------------- TABLE 3: GAP ANALYSIS BY OPEN ISSUE ----------------
obj = [
 ("Covered peril: burst pipe is water damage", ["EV-09","EV-10","EV-12","EV-14"],"Confirm the failure is a plumbing rupture within the Water Damage peril."),
 ("Seepage-over-14-days exclusion", ["EV-09","EV-10","EV-24","EV-27","EV-28","EV-25"],"Show single event vs. continuous/repeated leakage."),
 ("Freezing exclusion", ["EV-33","EV-32","EV-38","EV-09"],"Show heat maintained and building occupied; check DOL temps."),
 ("Wear/tear & corrosion", ["EV-27","EV-12","EV-28"],"Allocate failed component vs. ensuing damage."),
 ("Faulty workmanship", ["EV-29","EV-31"],"Identify any recent defective repair as cause."),
 ("Vacancy exclusion", ["EV-32","EV-34","EV-37"],"Establish occupancy within the period."),
 ("Mold/fungus sublimit", ["EV-15","EV-23","EV-24","EV-25"],"Quantify separate mold exposure."),
 ("Sewer backup vs. supply line", ["EV-09","EV-11"],"Confirm line type (affects which endorsement applies)."),
 ("Limit / deductible structure", ["EV-01","EV-03","EV-21","EV-04"],"Confirm $500k and $5k application."),
 ("Coinsurance & valuation (RCV/ACV)", ["EV-02","EV-17","EV-20","EV-21"],"Test coinsurance and depreciation."),
 ("Prompt notice / suit limitation", ["EV-05","EV-07","EV-08","EV-04","EV-43"],"Establish notice timing and contractual bar."),
 ("Duty to mitigate", ["EV-23","EV-24","EV-26","EV-33"],"Show post-loss conduct."),
 ("Insurable interest & payee", ["EV-37","EV-41"],"Confirm claimant interest and correct payee."),
 ("Subrogation potential", ["EV-31","EV-40","EV-09"],"Identify recoverable third-party/defective-work claims."),
]
gap = pd.DataFrame(obj, columns=["Open coverage issue","Evidence items that resolve it","Purpose"])

print("="*140)
print(f"EVIDENCE FILE SCHEDULE - Policy CP-2024-1187 | Claim ref: {CLAIM_REF} | Prepared: {TODAY} | FNOL date: {FNOL_DATE}")
print("NOTE: No document is asserted to exist. All items are records to be requested and verified.")
print("="*140)
counts = ev.groupby(["Category","Priority"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
print("\n--- A. EVIDENCE SCHEDULE SUMMARY (item counts by category & priority) ---")
print(counts.to_string())
print(f"\nTotal evidence items scheduled: {len(ev)}   |   Critical: {(ev['Priority']=='Critical').sum()}"
      f"   High: {(ev['Priority']=='High').sum()}   Medium: {(ev['Priority']=='Medium').sum()}   Low: {(ev['Priority']=='Low').sum()}")
print("\n--- B. FULL MASTER EVIDENCE SCHEDULE ---")
print(ev.to_string(index=False))
print("\n--- C. CHAIN-OF-CUSTODY LOG (template - empty, ready to populate) ---")
print(coc.to_string(index=False) if len(coc) else "  [No receipts logged yet - all items Outstanding]")
print("\n--- D. GAP ANALYSIS: EVIDENCE MAPPED TO OPEN COVERAGE ISSUES ---")
print(gap.to_string(index=False))
```
